column1: # Row-format golden corpus (card C-T6a1): one row per line, a version-1
# row of a single nullable column of the stem's type
# (stem <TAB> sql_literal <TAB> hex). The literals are parsed by
# tests/common (the same parser as the key corpus); the hex column pins
# the C-T6 §2 bytes: 52 01 be32(1) be16(1) nullmap datum. Unlike the key
# corpus the bytes are lossless (§2.1): -0, 1.50, '1 mon' vs '30 days'
# and jsonb duplicate keys each keep their own row. Regenerate the hex
# column only with: cargo test -p nucleus-codec --test row_gen -- --ignored
